newsitem.title: USA: Strategia says rest of yr to show rev growth.
newsitem.headline: Strategia says rest of yr to show rev growth.

text.p: Strategia Corp said Friday it believes the balance of 1997 will show continued growth in revenues from its services for solving what is known as the year 2000 problem.

Strategia also said it plans to continue to expand its year 2000 capabilities with additional personnel, facilities, and equipment for the rest of the year to meet anticipated demand for its services in 1998 and beyond.
The company said its "millennium services business" became a more important segment of its revenue base in the second quarter.

The year 2000 problem arises from the two-digit date fields encoded into many computer systems and software. When the year 2000 changes over, these systems may misinterpret the "00" date field as "1900," and crash or lose data.
The company said expenditures for the second quarter increased significantly as it prepared for anticipated strong demand for its millennium services.
The company also said it made "critical investments" in growing its technical and marketing staff, opening a new compliance testing center, and advertising and promoting its services.
The company reported a loss per share for the quarter of $0.01 compared to a loss of $0.10 for the same period a year ago. Revenues were $2.8 million compared to $2.4 million.

The company said its second quarter results reflect certain post-offering professional expenses associated with its recent financing, including expenses related to its August 6th listing on the American Stock Exchange.
